exposure: Pharmacokinetic parameters measured by GRASP-MRI: Wash-in, Wash-out, time to peck (TTP), initial area under the curve (iAUC), the transfer rate constant (Ktrans), constant flow rate (Kep), and volume of extracellular space (Ve)
outcome: Intraoperative bleeding risk during curettage for cesarean scar pregnancy
cohort: Patients with cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) who underwent curettage
finding: GRASP DCE-MRI, particularly Wash-in values, has the potential to predict intraoperative hemorrhage risk during curettage for CSP.
